en.title: Maxwell's Demon
en.teaser: A microscopic gatekeeper sorts fast and slow particles, revealing the profound physical cost of information and memory erasure.

en.hook: Can an intelligent microscopic gatekeeper break the Second Law of Thermodynamics, or does information itself have a physical energy cost?
en.math: Maxwell proposed sorting hot and cold particles without work, but Landauer proved that erasing information always dissipates heat.
en.question: Can we simulate Maxwell's demon, kinetic gas sorting, and Landauer's erasure limit live in Kotlin Multiplatform?
en.code_tip: We model particle kinetics in dual chambers, evaluate information bits processed, and compute total universal entropy on Canvas.
en.payoff: Maxwell's demon and Landauer's principle running live in Kotlin.
